project.name: Berth
project.description: Local named TCP port leases, dashboard of leases + observed listeners, Windows firewall sync. Humans still use the port.

exitCriteriaMet: Product shape locked (leases + dashboard + firewall, observed rows, name Berth, path /berth)

notes: Kickoff from Engram Tailscale/firewall session. Model B only — not a reverse proxy.

exitCriteriaRemaining: Hero flow: claim → get → dashboard → firewall

decisions.decision: Model B: named port leases. Humans always use the numeric port.
decisions.rationale: Phone/Tailscale/bookmarks and firewall rules are port contracts. A localhost proxy does not fix that.

decisions.decision: v1 = stable leases + dashboard + Windows firewall sync; observed listeners in the same board.
decisions.rationale: Engram timed out on Tailscale because the firewall rule was still on 5173 after the app moved to 5193.

decisions.decision: Product name Berth; repo path berth. Keep the berth CLI name locally; do not publish unscoped global until PATH collisions are decided.
decisions.rationale: Metaphor fits. Folder is free. Global `berth` binary is already used by MCP/WhenLabs/worktree tools.

sessions.summary: Sibling kickoff. Product shape locked. Brief drafted. Waiting on stack/data-home/license/port lock.
